scene.primarySubject: The Levite, standing tense and grim, knife in hand, beside the still body of the concubine.
scene.action: He is in the act of dividing her body, the knife raised at the moment before the cutting.
scene.setting: Interior of a modest stone house in Gibeah of Benjamin, with a clay lamp, low stone bench and bundled travel supplies.
scene.secondaryElements: The donkey tethered faintly visible through the open doorway; the walled distant hill of Gibeah beyond the threshold in the dark.
scene.mood: Stark horror and grim resolve, restrained rather than gory.
scene.timeOfDay: Deep night, dim lamplight and moonlight through the doorway, still dry air.
scene.composition: Interior view from the doorway, the Levite placed centrally in lamplight, the concubine's body low in the foreground, the knife as the focal point.

packet.verseText: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

availableCast.name: Jesus Christ, the Son of God and Lord

scene.primarySubject: Saul of Tarsus, a traveling Jewish man in a dusty tunic and cloak, halted mid-stride with arm raised against the light
scene.action: A sudden radiant light from the sky floods the road around Saul and his companions
scene.setting: Dusty desert road approaching Damascus, sun-baked stone and scrub, distant city walls under a cloudless sky
scene.secondaryElements: Companions in road-worn tunics and sandals shielding their eyes and staggering back; a dust cloud kicked up along the road; the glowing light as a radiant column from heaven without any visible form
scene.mood: Awe, startled reverence and overwhelming shock
scene.timeOfDay: Midday turning to blazing noon light, clear cloudless sky
scene.composition: Wide view from the roadside, Saul centered in the flood of light with companions arranged around him and Damascus visible on the horizon

packet.verseText: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

availableCast.name: Jesus Christ, the Son of God and Lord

scene.primarySubject: Jesus standing at the tomb mouth, arm raised and face lifted in a loud call.
scene.action: Lazarus, still bound in grave-cloths, steps forth from the dark cave into the light.
scene.setting: A rock-cut tomb in a garden outside Jerusalem, with the great round stone set ready against the entrance.
scene.secondaryElements: Martha and onlookers in the crowd stand near, some shielding their eyes, the grave-cloths trailing from Lazarus's hands and feet.
scene.mood: Awe, stunned hope and reverent astonishment.
scene.timeOfDay: Late afternoon, clear and warm Judean daylight.
scene.composition: Tomb opening framed at the center, Jesus in the foreground facing the cave, crowd arranged around the entrance, Lazarus emerging from shadow into light.

packet.verseText: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

availableCast.name: David son of Jesse (king of Israel)

scene.primarySubject: David reclining on the grass, relaxed and at rest
scene.action: Lying down among the grazing sheep, having been led to the pasture
scene.setting: Green hill pasture of Judea beside a still stream, with stone terraces and a distant village
scene.secondaryElements: Sheep lying and grazing nearby, a staff and leather sling resting on the grass, water glinting in the stream
scene.mood: Peaceful, trusting and restful
scene.timeOfDay: Late morning, bright and clear with a few high soft clouds
scene.composition: Medium wide view from slightly above, David in the lower middle with the stream curving into the background
